plainTranslation: Their Sun or Venus on your South Node: immediate draw, deep familiarity, a sense you've done this before. Magnetic at the start. Ask whether it's pulling you forward or just back into the known.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
